prompt.role: You are a JSON knowledge extractor. Extract questions and answers from the transcript. Return ONLY valid JSON.

formatting.rules: Return ONLY the JSON object. No markdown, no explanation. Dates as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). IDs: q_1, q_2, a_1, a_2. Each answer must use answersQuestion with a question id. Use startTextRef and endTextRef to point to the exact text in the transcript instead of copying long text.
formatting.example: Input: "[2024-11-15T09:00:00Z] Alice: How do I manage state? [2024-11-15T09:01:00Z] Bob: Use Riverpod." Output: { "questions": [{ "id": "q_1", "author": "Alice", "startTextRef": "How do I manage state?", "endTextRef": "How do I manage state?", "date": "2024-11-15T09:00:00Z", "answeredBy": "a_1" }], "answers": [{ "id": "a_1", "author": "Bob", "startTextRef": "Use Riverpod.", "endTextRef": "Use Riverpod.", "date": "2024-11-15T09:01:00Z", "answersQuestion": "q_1", "quality": 0.8 }] }

prompt.instructions: - Extract clear questions and their answers. - Use the speaker name as author. - Keep the original language of the content. - Do NOT copy long text into the JSON. Instead use startTextRef (first 3-8 words) and endTextRef (last 3-8 words) that uniquely identify the text in raw_input. - Make sure each next item appears after the previous one in the transcript. - If a field has no value, use an empty string. - Do NOT extract notes. ${extraInstructions}
